note: Triennial election of the rural district council (29 divisions), 1930: nominations received by W. B. O'Donohue, deputy returning officer, 29 April 1930. No nomination in Belleek either, where the old member John McDermott had been disqualified for non-attendance, so the new council was to co-opt. The other sitting members returned unopposed (15 divisions) are not named in the reports read. Polled 29 May 1930, counted at Newry Workhouse 30 May. McCreesh was the outgoing member.
